sections.title: Worship & Chapel Life
sections.subtitle: Spiritual Growth & Fellowship
sections.description: Daily chapel services, student-led praise and worship, prayer gatherings, and spiritual retreat days form the heartbeat of spiritual formation at Glory Education Center.

sections.title: Campus Life
sections.subtitle: Community & Living
sections.description: Our residential and commuter campus offers a vibrant community life where lifelong friendships are built through communal meals, sports, cultural events, and ministry outreach.

sections.title: Theological Library
sections.subtitle: Academic Excellence & Research
sections.description: Houses over 25,000 volumes, rare theological commentaries, digital research databases, quiet study rooms, and high-speed internet for comprehensive academic research.

sections.title: Music Department
sections.subtitle: Worship Arts & Performance
sections.description: Equipped with state-of-the-art practice rooms, sound recording facilities, pianos, key instruments, and choir halls to nurture musical gifts for global ministry.

sections.title: Student Events & Outreaches
sections.subtitle: Practical Ministry & Impact
sections.description: Students participate in weekend church ministries, community gospel outreaches, music fests, youth camps, and social service projects across urban and rural communities.

sections.title: Community & Care
sections.subtitle: Mentorship & Discipleship
sections.description: Every student is paired with a faculty mentor for personal discipleship, academic guidance, and pastoral counseling throughout their time at GEC.
